entries.title: Wall segment
entries.description: Straight full-height wall segment. Length runs along local +X, thickness along local +Y.
entries.note: Synthetic reviewed defaults for planning; not measured from any site.

lengthM.description: Wall length along local X in meters.

widthM.description: Wall thickness along local Y in meters.

isaac.notes: Scaled Cube prim with static collision.

entries.title: Structural column
entries.description: Square or rectangular building column. Collision is the conservative bounding box even when displayed as a cylinder.
entries.note: Synthetic reviewed defaults for planning; not measured from any site.

lengthM.description: Column size along local X in meters.

widthM.description: Column size along local Y in meters.

isaac.notes: Cylinder prim; collision exported as the bounding Cube.

entries.title: Rack bay
entries.description: Single selective pallet rack bay. Length is the beam span along local X, width is the rack depth along local Y.
entries.note: Synthetic reviewed defaults for planning; not measured from any site.

lengthM.description: Beam span along local X in meters.

widthM.description: Rack depth along local Y in meters.

heightM.description: Top of the highest beam in meters.

isaac.notes: Scaled Cube prim with static collision.

entries.title: Rack row
entries.description: Row of identical rack bays sharing uprights. Length along local X covers all bays; width is the rack depth along local Y.
entries.note: Synthetic reviewed defaults for planning; not measured from any site. Depth is expressed as widthM to match instance dimensions.

lengthM.description: Total row length along local X in meters.

widthM.description: Rack depth along local Y in meters.

heightM.description: Top of the highest beam in meters.

bays.description: Number of bays in the row.

isaac.notes: Xform containing one Cube per bay; collision is the whole row box.

entries.title: Pallet
entries.description: Loaded or empty pallet resting on the floor.
entries.note: Synthetic reviewed defaults for planning; not measured from any site.

lengthM.description: Pallet length along local X in meters.

widthM.description: Pallet width along local Y in meters.

heightM.description: Total height including load in meters.

isaac.notes: Scaled Cube prim with static collision.

entries.title: Door opening
entries.description: Opening in a wall. Only the header above clearanceM up to heightM collides, so robots below the clearance pass through.
entries.note: Synthetic reviewed defaults for planning; not measured from any site.

lengthM.description: Opening width along local X in meters.

widthM.description: Wall thickness along local Y in meters.

heightM.description: Top of the wall above the opening in meters.

clearanceM.description: Clear height under the header in meters.

isaac.notes: Header Cube prim positioned above the clearance height.

entries.title: Work station
entries.description: Pickup, dropoff or holding position marked on the floor. Low collision volume so a robot can stop on it without obstruction above.
entries.note: Synthetic reviewed defaults for planning; not measured from any site.

lengthM.description: Station length along local X in meters.

widthM.description: Station width along local Y in meters.

isaac.notes: Thin Cube prim marker without collision in Isaac.

entries.title: Charging dock
entries.description: Floor-standing charging dock. Robots approach along local -X.
entries.note: Synthetic reviewed defaults for planning; not measured from any site.

lengthM.description: Dock depth along local X in meters.

widthM.description: Dock width along local Y in meters.

isaac.notes: Scaled Cube prim with static collision.

entries.title: Differential-drive robot
entries.description: Generic differential-drive mobile robot. Body 0.8 x 0.6 m; loaded footprint 1.0 x 0.7 m centered on the load offset.
entries.note: Synthetic reviewed defaults for planning; not a vendor datasheet.

lengthM.description: Body length along local X in meters.

widthM.description: Body width along local Y in meters.

isaac.notes: Xform with a body Cube; drive articulation is mapped by the export capability.

entries.title: Omnidirectional robot
entries.description: Generic omnidirectional mobile robot. Body 0.8 x 0.6 m; loaded footprint 1.0 x 0.7 m centered on the body.
entries.note: Synthetic reviewed defaults for planning; not a vendor datasheet.

lengthM.description: Body length along local X in meters.

widthM.description: Body width along local Y in meters.

isaac.notes: Xform with a body Cube; holonomic base is mapped by the export capability.
